description: Graph mutation intents announced from the LGraph and widget-value funnels with caller provenance, plus the probe that tells id allocation whether a root graph is bound to a collaborative document. The agent CRDT minter and applier consume these seams from outside this domain.

characterizationScenarios.name: Graph mutations emit intents tagged with local, load, or agent-remote provenance
Agent document minting and applying observe graph intents

compatibilityPromises: Intent provenance stays synchronous and innermost-wins: configure is load, the CRDT applier is agent-remote, and other callers are local.
LiteGraph pulls the doc-bound probe at mint time and never imports the application layer to answer it.
